subject: Implement QueryService for Layer 3 database operations
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/database/queries.py` with async service methods for read-only query execution and EXPLAIN PLAN adaptation.

Methods to implement:
- `validate_query(sql) -> bool`: Read-only validation
  - Blocked keyword regex: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, CREATE, ALTER, TRUNCATE, GRANT, REVOKE (case-insensitive, word boundary matching)
  - Query must start with SELECT or WITH
  - Returns validation result with error details if invalid
- `async def execute_query(pool, sql, params, limit, timeout_ms) -> ExecuteQueryOutput`
  - Validates query is read-only
  - Auto-appends LIMIT if query doesn't have one
  - Uses parameterized queries via hdbcli (positional `?` or named `:param`)
  - Sets statement timeout if configured
  - Returns columns, rows, row_count, has_more, execution_time, query_hash
  - Measures execution time
  - Generates query hash for deduplication
- `async def explain_query(pool, sql, params, format) -> ExplainQueryOutput`
  - HANA-specific EXPLAIN PLAN adaptation:
    1. Generate unique statement name (UUID-based)
    2. Execute `EXPLAIN PLAN SET STATEMENT_NAME = '{uuid}' FOR {sql}`
    3. Read results from `EXPLAIN_PLAN_TABLE` filtered by statement name
    4. Clean up: DELETE from `EXPLAIN_PLAN_TABLE` WHERE STATEMENT_NAME = '{uuid}'
  - Cleanup in finally block (never skip)
  - Return plan operators with names, engines, and details

All methods use `asyncio.to_thread()` for hdbcli calls.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Query validation blocks all write keywords (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, CREATE, ALTER, TRUNCATE, GRANT, REVOKE)
- [ ] Query validation enforces SELECT/WITH start
- [ ] `execute_query` uses parameterized queries (never string interpolation)
- [ ] Auto-LIMIT appended when query lacks one
- [ ] `explain_query` implements write-read-cleanup cycle with unique statement names
- [ ] Execution time measured and reported

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Subqueries containing blocked keywords in string literals: not falsely blocked
- [ ] `WITH` CTE queries: allowed
- [ ] Query already has LIMIT: don't double-add
- [ ] Concurrent EXPLAIN calls: UUID-based names prevent conflicts
- [ ] EXPLAIN_PLAN_TABLE doesn't exist: clear error with guidance

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Write attempt: returns WRITE_OPERATION_DENIED with clear explanation
- [ ] Query timeout: returns QUERY_TIMEOUT with suggestion to add filters
- [ ] Permission denied: returns PERMISSION_DENIED with grant guidance
- [ ] EXPLAIN cleanup failure: logged as warning, doesn't fail the response

_Performance:_
- [ ] Statement timeout respected (configurable, default 30s)

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Query validation with various write keyword positions
• Unit: Query validation allows valid SELECT/WITH queries
• Unit: Auto-LIMIT append logic
• Unit: EXPLAIN PLAN write-read-cleanup cycle (mocked)
• Unit: Parameterized query parameter binding
• Unit: Execution time measurement

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.3, 6.2, 9.2
